content.html:
（例）国会ではしつぎが行われていた。

1　祖母は私にれいぎや作法を教えてくれた。

2　ぎせいしゃは、数十人にのぼるという。

3　その件は現在しんぎ中だ。

4　ぎわくをまねくようなことはするな。

例の文の　　　の言葉は「質疑」と書きます。1から4の言葉はそれぞれ、1は「礼儀」、2は「犠牲者」、3は「審議」、4は「疑惑」と書きます。例の文の「質疑」の「疑」と、4の「疑惑」の「疑」は同じ漢字ですから、答えは4です。

（例）①　②　③　●

（解答用紙）

context: Vocabulary Problem IV worked example: select the alternative whose tested ぎ is written with the same kanji as 質疑.

alternatives.value: Retain the same native text without reconstructed underlines.
alternatives.assessment: This preserves literal text but leaves the tested subpart visually unspecified; the explanation explicitly identifies 疑 and answer 4.
Omitting the worked example would discard a complete native witness absent from the collection.

evidence.source_label: 2008年日语能力考试1级真题及答案 — native DOC text
evidence.reading: 国会ではしつぎが行われていた。 Four alternatives end in れいぎ, ぎせいしゃ, しんぎ, ぎわく; the explanation explicitly compares 疑 with 疑 and says 答えは４です。
evidence.lineage: Common ancestry with the collection is possible; shared errors are not independent votes.

evidence.source_label: 1995–2009.12 日本语能力测试真题详解 N1, 2011 collection, 2008 Level 1
evidence.locator: Problem IV heading followed immediately by scored 36–40; no worked example
evidence.reading: The question heading specifies the doubly underlined subpart. The example is absent.

rationale: The full sentence, four alternatives, explanation and filled fourth answer mark are present in the DOC. Its explicit kanji comparison establishes the intended tested syllable. The native character runs do not establish selective underline endpoints, so the annotation reconstruction remains provisional.
resolution_attempts: Compared the native DOC’s complete Problem IV example and explanatory paragraph with the collection’s Problem IV opening.
Inspected direct character-property runs across CP 2255–2491; they do not supply selective underline distinctions.
Checked all native subdocument counts: no additional textbox, footnote, comment or header story is present.
Attempted document rendering, but the registered word processor executable is unavailable. No rendered DOC layout is claimed.
remaining_uncertainty: A readable image or a functional layout rendering of this exact example could establish the original underline runs and answer-sheet arrangement. The current annotations are a supported inference, not a visual transcription.

context: Reading Problem III(5), graph comparing company selection reasons in 1971 and 2007. The current source crop still prints 11 beside the 2007 technical-training point.

alternatives.assessment: Taking the printed 11 literally makes the technical-training increase only 4 points, below the interesting-work increase of 5; this would favor choice 3.
The plotted height, collection explanation and survey publisher agree on approximately 14%, which makes choice 2 correct. This is the retained key.

evidence.source_label: 1995–2009.12 日本语能力测试真题详解 N1, 2011 collection, 2008 Level 1
evidence.locator: Graph, filled-square series 技術が覚えられるから
evidence.reading: 2007 label 11 beside a point plotted near 14%; 1971 label 7.

evidence.source_label: 1995–2009.12 日本语能力测试真题详解 N1, 2011 collection, 2008 Level 1
evidence.reading: Key 2; explanation uses 7%→14% and an increase of 7 percentage points.

evidence.source_label: Japan Productivity Center, 2007 new employee survey, 27 June 2007
evidence.locator: Main results, company selection criteria; accessed 26 October 2026
evidence.reading: 技術が覚えられるから: 14.1%

rationale: The intended rounded value is strongly supported as 14. The original crop remains available for exact comparison, while its numeric-label correction is explicitly deferred with the figure integration work. Answer 2 is supported; the inconsistent crop must not be presented as an unqualified final practice graphic.
resolution_attempts: Inspected the complete graph and enlarged source crop, including legend, axes, markers and printed values.
Compared the collection’s written key and full explanation with all four alternatives.
Checked the DOC native text and subdocument counts; it provides the choices/key but no recoverable graph.
Read the translation comparator’s written pages; the graph is absent and its final page is blank.
Located the cited survey publisher’s original 2007 results and verified 14.1%, 21.3% and 28.8%.
remaining_uncertainty: The exact exam-era graphic has not been established independently. The current displayed crop contains a confirmed erroneous label; integration must change that label to the supported rounded value 14 and verify all other source pixels/data against the retained original crop.
